outcome: Apgar score one minute after delivery
finding: Although fetal scalp blood pH correlated with umbilical cord pH and Apgar scores, it should not be considered a definitive indicator for emergency cesarean sections.
mod_finding: Fetal scalp pH sampling can be used as a complementary test, in conjunction with cardiotocography, to indicate whether an emergency cesarean section is necessary due to loss of fetal well-being.
